newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber extends losses at close.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber extends losses at close.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices extended midday losses at the close, with traders saying there was no positive news to move the market the other way.
"It was a quiet day through and through...no inquiries or buying," said a trader.
The Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted May RSS1 buyer at 287.50 cents ($1.14) a kg, down two cents from Wednesday. May SMR20 buyer was 1.50 cents lower at 270.50.
Trading houses offered the SMR 20 at 271 cents a kg, SMR CV at 342, SMR L at 322, SMR 5 at 282, SMR 10 at 272 and drum latex FOB at 231.
A trader said buyers may be inclined to come into the market next week if prices slipped by another one or two cents.

The INRO five-day moving indicator was quoted at 220.39 Malaysian/Singaporean cents per kg on April 16, compared to the 221.19 on April 15. The daily indicator was also lower at 218.42 from 219.83 previously.
